propositions: The N=3000 import benchmark calls author() 6,000 times, executing git config user.name once per envelope via subprocess, consuming 47.79s of 89.607s total (cProfile attribution)

The batch_stage_and_commit path calls sweep_stale_staging 3,000 times during CREATE staging, performing 375,876 redundant owner checks and consuming 15.938s, though the same staging root is rescanned while earlier items remain unpublished

Replacing only the git-config and sweep mechanisms with side-effect-free logical equivalents (identical state, 3,000 creates, 3,000 comments, 29 total commits) reduces execution from 77.231s to 16.404s, eliminating 60.827s (78.8%) without changing event bytes, attribution, or crash-safe commit count
The optimization must preserve N=3000, 6,000 events, exactly 24 import commits, >=10x reduction, crash-resume, rollback, and interactive per-write author lookup and sweep behavior
Interactive and direct writes must retain live author lookup and full stale-sweep behavior; cache and batch optimizations must not leak across independent writes, threads, tasks, or sessions
